meta.matching: One token per RGB value; hex, rgb() and rgba() spellings of the same colour are one token. alphas lists every opacity the board uses it at.

applied.live: colour Unity applies at runtime: lamp and glyph tints, bar cells, fills, lines
applied.page css: browser page only, not the board

verification.method: getComputedStyle over every rendered element: background, background-image, box-shadow, text colour and text-shadow on text, border and outline where drawn, SVG fill and stroke, ::before/::after

board.ground.job: Board root ground under the steel canvas.

ink.label.job: Labels on metal; lowered periscope lens.

black.job: Glass ground; every drop and inset shadow (alpha varies by use).

white.job: Lit data-bar cells; bevel highlights and glints (alpha varies by use).

ink.frameStencil.job: Stencils and hairlines painted on the frame and panel faces, at 20 to 40% alpha.

ink.caption.job: Captions over readouts: MISSION, RATE, SUBJECT, HDG, THR.

ink.data.job: Data on metal; lit selector ink; white grid tint.

accent.alarm.job: Vent, alarm, hostile. Also the periscope sight and own ship on the red grid.

tint.tool.job: Tool-rail glyph tint; plot annotation labels (board point, predicted position).

ink.railLegend.job: Rail key legends (SEL, PNT, RUL, CMP, ERS) and the periscope slew legend.

ink.plotScale.job: Plot axis numerals and axis titles.

accent.ownForce.job: Own force; plot marks; hangar and comms own-force readouts.

ink.legend.job: Legends beside hardware: THRUST, HEADING, throttle F and 0, DRADIS OFF.

accent.nominal.job: Nominal, DRAW, friendly. Also phosphor labels and chrome.

ink.arcLabel.job: PDC arc label on the plot, dim amber.

contact.boardingVector.job: Boarding cutter BC-01 course vector on the plot, shown while contact 22 is resolved and unacknowledged.

ink.secondary.job: Secondary readout text; inactive pause and rate labels.

ink.engraved.job: Engraved text on aluminium legend and data plates.

ink.wellStencil.job: Stencils in recessed wells and on glass (UNITS, ATMO, CREW, ACTING ON).

phosphor.bright.job: Bright data on phosphor screens; top of the array-gain lit track.

phosphor.trackFoot.job: Foot of the array-gain lit-track gradient.

phosphor.trackGlow.job: Glow round the array-gain lit track, 35%.

cell.coreUnlit.job: Unlit reactor core cell. Also a knurl and knob stop in sprites.

lamp.offPanel.job: Unlit lamp on a panel face (rockers, stages, launch, recall, sight, capacitor). Also a panel-body gradient stop in sprites.

steel.fallbackFoot.job: Steel fallback gradient foot, used only without WebGL. Also a panel-body stop in sprites.

ink.stencilDim.job: Dim stencils on metal; unlit lamp tint.

accent.alarmShade.job: Foot of the throttle lit-fill gradient (shade stop of accent.alarm); also baked in thrown rocker paddles.

page.background.job: Browser page outside the 1920x1080 board. Not part of the board.

page.linkHover.job: Link hover colour in the page CSS. No link on the board uses it.

lamp.offSelector.job: Unlit selector, squad and channel lamps.

bezel.selectedTop.job: Selected squad screen bezel, gradient top.

bezel.selectedFoot.job: Selected squad screen bezel, gradient foot.

sweep.red.job: Radar sweep on the red grid, 50%.

sweep.redEdge.job: Radar sweep leading edge on the red grid, 75%.

lamp.off.job: Unlit tool-rail lamp; unselected compartment ring.

ink.inactive.job: Unselected mode names (autopilot modes, periscope stub).

lamp.cautionHot.job: Hot centre of a lit interlock lamp.

steel.fallbackTop.job: Steel fallback gradient top, used only without WebGL.

findings: Contact 22 boarding vector is purple #9B7FD4, outside the palette. Exported as found.
The red grid uses #FF6E50, #FF7C58 and #FF6E46, and the red sweep #FF8C78 and #FF9682, not the grid tint #E04B3C named in the design rules. Exported as found.
The PDC arc label uses a dim amber #8A6A2A. Exported as found.
Four render values are computed and never read by the template: setToggles[].ink, compartments[].lamp, orderSwitches[].costInk, orderSwitches[].ink.
The design rules list #6B757C (section headers) and #3E464C (well stencils). Neither renders on the board.
